content.title: Dispatch delivery SLA definition and comparison policy
content.body: Recurring dispatch metric: overall on_time_delivery SLA attainment is parcels delivered by the promised window divided by all parcels due, including overdue undelivered parcels, excluding cancellations, across the service tiers in the Delivery service metric-of-record export. Use source-declared UTC reporting windows and compare the current complete reporting week with the previous complete week. Compare overall controlling totals; tier breakdowns are explanatory only, never independent alert rules. A drop of at least 0.05 ratio units triggers the authorized business route; parcel volume alone is not adverse. If either week is incomplete or non-comparable, or eligible parcel counts are missing, use insufficient_data to Data Operations and no business alert; request a corrected export. If independently validated overall totals are usable but optional tier detail is missing, proceed on the overall check and state that limitation. No general freshness limit has been defined; settle any operational freshness requirement before unattended delivery. This entry preserves reusable definition and policy, not any snapshot measurement.
